Who We Are

Rooted in the Word, reaching the world

We are a Bible-believing, healing-centred ministry built on one conviction: that the gospel restores what life has broken — bodies, families, and nations.

Healing Centre Ministries International exists to carry the message of Christ to every corner of the earth, symbolised in our own emblem — the globe encircled in gold, the open Bible as our foundation, and the dove descending as a sign of the Spirit's presence among us.

Whatever season you're walking through, you are welcome at our table. We gather to worship freely, study the Word deeply, and pray for one another expectantly.

  • Christ-centred worship and sound biblical teaching
  • A dedicated place and time of prayer for healing and breakthrough
  • A welcoming family for newcomers and visitors, every week
  • Ministry that reaches beyond our walls, into our city and nations

Our Emblem

The dove for the Spirit, the globe for our reach to the nations, and the open Bible as the ground we stand on — three symbols, one calling.

What We Do

Ministries built around healing and growth

Every ministry here is an extension of the same purpose — to see people made whole in spirit, soul, and body.

1

Healing & Prayer

Dedicated services of prayer and ministration for physical, emotional, and spiritual healing.

2

Bible Study

Grounded teaching that builds a lasting, working knowledge of Scripture for daily life.

3

Outreach & Missions

Carrying the gospel and practical support into our community and beyond, hand in hand.

4

Family & Youth

Nurturing children, teens, and young adults in a faith that will carry them for life.

5

Counselling

One-on-one pastoral support for marriage, grief, and the everyday weight of life.

6

Choir & Worship

Leading the church into the presence of God through music and heartfelt praise.
